objectClass.primaryType: spiral galaxy emblem — volumetric astronomical scene (particle-dominant)
objectClass.notes: No character anatomy. Identity lives in the two-arm spiral winding, the warm core against the cool blue/violet disc, and the traced arm hotspots — all emissive; no matte/metallic surfaces.

reasoning: Silhouette irregular (spiral arms extend past the disc) but bounding volume is a single tilted disc — 2/3.
Three macro assemblies (disc/spiral system, bulge+core, star-field backdrop); arms and sprite layers are meso; hotspots/dust/diffraction crosses are micro.
Repetition density is high by construction: hundreds of additive point sprites form the arms and backdrop — 3/3.
Materials are emission-dominated (arms, core, stars) plus dark absorptive dust streaks; no PBR dielectric/metal surface.
Occlusion limited to the disc's far side; single-view ambiguity resolved by deterministic seeding and documented as stylization.
Avatar use: static framing, slow rigid rotation only — no sockets, articulation or destruction seams.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Particle repetition systems and per-region emissive overrides ARE the identity; the avatar is a static camera subject, so action-rigging depth is intentionally shallow (root group pivot only).

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.observation: Two dominant arms trail counter-clockwise outward from a short bar; ~1.5 visible windings each
Core gradient #fff7d9 → #ffc46b → #ff8a3c center→rim, cross-shaped diffraction bloom
Bright white-cyan knots traced along both arms, denser at mid-radius
Foreground stars carry 4-point diffraction crosses; backdrop stars are plain points
Dark #101226 filaments ride the inner edges of both arms, semi-opaque

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: At dashboard avatar size (30–96 px) and at review size (512 px), the model reads as the reference: a two-arm spiral galaxy with a warm golden core inside a cool blue→violet disc on near-black space.
Spiral chirality matches the reference (arms trail counter-clockwise outward); arm count is two dominant plus faint outer fragments.
Core-to-arm contrast reads warm-vs-cool at a glance; the arm hue ramp runs cyan (inner) → violet (outer).
All placement noise is seeded; the model renders identically across reloads.
The avatar renders at ≤6k triangles plus point sprites and holds ≥30 fps in the shared avatar runtime.

featureGroups.name: Two-arm logarithmic spiral with correct chirality
qualityCriteria: Arms originate at the bulge ends of a short bar and wind outward counter-clockwise, ~1.5 visible windings.
Arm width widens and brightness falls with radius; gaps between arms expose dark space.
Faint outer arm fragments extend past the dominant pair without forming a ring.
failureModes: arms read as concentric rings instead of a spiral

featureGroups.name: Warm bulge/core against cool disc
qualityCriteria: Core gradient runs #fff7d9 → #ffc46b → #ff8a3c center→rim with a soft additive bloom and a subtle 4-point diffraction cross.
Core diameter ≈ 0.18–0.24 of disc diameter; bloom never washes out the inner arm region.
failureModes: core bloom covers > 0.35 of the disc

featureGroups.name: Arm hue ramp and traced hotspots
qualityCriteria: Arm particles ramp cyan #7fd4ff (inner) → blue #4f7dff → violet #9b5cff (outer) as ordered stops, not a single flat blue.
White-cyan hotspot knots trace both arms, denser at mid-radius, individually resolvable at 512 px review size.
failureModes: hotspots scattered uniformly instead of tracing arms

featureGroups.name: Star field backdrop and dark dust filaments
qualityCriteria: Backdrop: scattered white-blue points (a few with 4-point diffraction crosses) over #050510–#0a0a18 space with slight vignette.
Dark dust streaks ride the inner edges of the arms, semi-opaque #101226, never covering arm glow entirely.
failureModes: flat black background with no star field
dust lanes read as grey smears across the whole disc

visualDeltaChecks: Silhouette IoU of the luminous envelope vs the reference ≥ 0.55 at review size (emissive scenes have soft envelopes; this is not a hard-object gate).
Core region hue stays warm (R channel > B channel in the core crop).
Arm region hue stays cool (B ≥ R in the arm crop).
antiShallowSpecRules: No single-sprite 'galaxy texture' planes — the spiral must be constructed from placed particles.
No unseeded Math.random anywhere; every stochastic placement records its seed.

authoringInstruction: Fill observed object class, complexity reasoning, featureGroups, visualDeltaChecks, and unknowns before generating or implementing ObjectSculptSpec.
